episodes.synopsis: Monsters are evil abominations driven by murderous instinct. But if that were true, why is this one a scared little girl who doesn’t understand why she’s being hunted?
episodes.title: Wiene Dragon's Daughter

episodes.synopsis: Who knows what could happen if word of Wiene’s existence spread. The Hestia Familia needs answers and soon, but what they discover in the dungeon only raises more questions...
episodes.title: Monster | One Wing

episodes.synopsis: The Guild knows about Wiene. But instead of demanding answers, it assigns the Hestia Familia a mission they cannot refuse. Something awaits them in the dungeon’s darkness.
episodes.title: Xenos | Outliers

episodes.synopsis: There are others like Wiene, and they call themselves Xenos. Uranus asks much from the Hestia Familia, but if anyone can bridge the gap between species, it’s them.
episodes.title: Aspiration | Distant Dream

episodes.synopsis: It was supposed to be the dawning of a new era. But selfish, evil men only care about what they can take for themselves, leaving others to face the consequences.
episodes.title: Ikelos Familia | King of Atrocity

episodes.synopsis: Bell shouldn’t get involved. But the young adventurer has already decided otherwise. Little does he know that he’ll help Fels discover a secret even Uranus doesn’t know.
episodes.title: Knossos | Man-Made Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: Never underestimate the measures a fanatic will take to prove his worldview correct.
episodes.title: Dix Perdix | The Dreams of Beasts

episodes.synopsis: The Loki Familia are battle-hardened veterans used to fighting monsters. But this opponent is different...
episodes.title: Bell Cranel | The Fool

episodes.synopsis: Although Ikelos has been successfully scapegoated, public opinion turns on Bell. Helping the Xenos will now prove impossible — but Hermes’ intel might just change the tide.
episodes.title: Stigma | Downfall

episodes.synopsis: The surface is no longer safe for the Xenos. Now, the Hestia Familia must smuggle them back into the Dungeon. There’s just one problem: The Loki Familia stand in the way.
episodes.title: Invisible | Forced Breakthrough

episodes.synopsis: Bell WILL stay true to his ideals. Even if that means making an enemy of the woman he loves.
episodes.title: Ultra Soul | Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: As Hermes finally reveals his true intentions, Bell battles the most powerful opponent he's ever faced.
episodes.title: Argonaut | Hero's Return
